AgentInput.tsx is the only call site of getDefaultModelContextWindow that needed adaptation; no other call sites of getModelContextWindow exist that depend on default-Claude=1M.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: 2026-04-24 spec-20260424-084848 — Cycle 6 over-corrected default Claude denominator from 200K→1M
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Cycle 6 trusted a user assertion at the time without anchoring to per-session metadata. The 2026-05-06 user reversal (saga §5.2 quote 4) made the value lie for the common case.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: M1 reverts the data-layer constant to the conservative 200K. M2 keeps the explicit-1M-marker detection working including the new bracket-suffix pattern. M3 adds the metadata-aware precedence the original Cycle 6 fix lacked. M3' adds the cross-package metadata emission that M3 needs to actually fire for normal-SDK users (closing the gap between ACP path and normal SDK path).

codex_consult.feedback_summary: 6 findings: (1) precedence inversion suggestion — REJECTED per BA-spec §M3 contract (Rule 4 — requirement wins); (2) markerless auto-upgrade for 1M Opus accounts — out_of_scope per BA-iter2 Q2 / spec R-1 residual-risk acceptance; (3) claudeLocalLauncher path not covered — covered-by-design (claudeLocal runs only on server-unreachable fallback with no session client; not the 'normal Claude SDK path' M3' targets); (4) display-latency race — out_of_scope per BA spec R-1 acceptance; (5) idempotency does not prevent metadata-version churn — IN_SCOPE_REAL_BUG, FIXED via createCurrentModelCodeEmitter stateful cache + 4 new dedicated test fixtures; (6) regex false-positive on whitespace around [1m] — nitpick, no real Anthropic model code matches.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Finding 5 fully fixed: introduced createCurrentModelCodeEmitter() with per-session lastEmitted cache so a repeated identical SDK system/init does not invoke updateMetadata at all (verified by 'emits exactly once for repeated identical system/init model values' + 'reset() clears cache' tests). Wired into Services struct in claudeRemoteLauncher.ts:initServices. Findings 1, 2, 4 explicitly held to BA-spec contract per Codex-skill Rule 4 — requirement wins; documented as conscious trade-offs. Finding 3 noted as covered-by-design. Codex-flagged /close risk on 'real 1M users still see 1M' is mitigated by M3' coverage of the documented marker patterns; markerless auto-upgrades remain accepted residual risk per BA spec R-1.

recommendations: QA should treat AC-2-LIVE-PERCENT-CORRECT as the gating criterion: capture screenshots showing ~50%-90% range gap between the (correct) 200K-denominator percentage and the (incorrect) 1M-denominator computation that pre-Cycle-10 would have shown.

If the user later wants codex Finding 1's precedence inversion (currentModelCode wins over explicit modelMode pick), that requires a /redev clarification — BA-spec §M3 currently authorizes the opposite ordering and the implementation is faithful to spec.
